newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kia raises 350 bln won on discounts.
newsitem.headline: Kia raises 350 bln won on discounts.

text.p: South Korea's troubled Kia Group raised an estimated 350 billion won in the past three days through cash discount sales on some vehicles, the head of Kia Group's vehicle sales unit said on Wednesday.
Yoo Young-gul, president of Kia Motor Sales Corp, told reporters the cash would be used to settle subcontractors' promissory notes and for emergency operations.
The nation's eighth largest industrial group ended deep price discounts on its main passenger car models late on Tuesday because of depleted inventories.
